NL3wrL55.retuning: g_rho chosen so S=25.68MeV at kF=1.15fm^-1, not at saturation
NL3wrL55.note: No coupling powers in this paper scalar terms: -kappa*phi^3/3! -lambda*phi^4/4!, unlike FSU2-family scaled fields; kappa column given in nucleon mass units. Published precision retained.

nonlinear_conventions.FSU2_family: Published g_i squared; paper rho vertex g_rho*tau3/2. Scalar interactions -kappa(g_sigma*sigma)^3/3! -lambda(g_sigma*sigma)^4/4!; omega +zeta*g_omega^4(omega_mu omega^mu)^2/4!; omega-rho +Lambda_omega*g_omega^2*g_rho^2(omega_mu omega^mu)(rho_mu rho^mu). Revised FSU2R/H have Lambda=.045, distinct from older.05.
nonlinear_conventions.TM1e: Author2020 guide explicitly g_rho/2. M*=M+g_sigma*sigma; map phi=-sigma to M*=M-g_sigma*phi, changing cubic coefficient sign only, not quartic. g2 given fm^-1. Do not import constants into another solver convention without transformation.
nonlinear_conventions.NL3wrL55: Avancini2012 Table1 uses rho/2 convention. Scalar terms use the bare scalar field phi, not g_sigma*phi: -kappa*phi^3/3! -lambda*phi^4/4!; kappa/M=4.384,lambda=-173.31. Do not apply FSU2 convention to these same numbers.
